ruleName: Limit of Clubs; Sharing, Adding or Replacing Clubs
title: Player Has Too Many Clubs in Bag During Stroke Play
question: On the 9th hole in a stroke play competition, Alison realises she has 15 clubs in her bag. She declares one club out of play. What is the ruling?

choices.text: There is no penalty if she declares a club out of play immediately.

explanation: Rule 4.1b imposes a penalty of two strokes for each hole where the breach occurred, with a maximum of four penalty strokes in stroke play. Alison must declare a club out of play to avoid further penalty for the remainder of the round.
